constrained.attention_patterns: recipient clean patterns frozen in all 36 layers
constrained.mlp_outputs_0_through_22: recipient clean outputs plus selected deltas

propagated.mlp_outputs: normal original MLP computation plus fixed clean selected deltas

protocol.transcoder_control: published 6 small and 6 hot features from assets/recipe.json; reproduce stored donor values, then compare both methods using freshly measured native donors
protocol.molt_contribution_definition: gate(x) * ((standardized prenorm residual x times V) times U) * output_std; output_mean is shared and cancels in delta
protocol.full_contribution_swap: move every selected contribution strength of the way from recipient to natural donor contribution; small features with zero donor contribution are suppressed
protocol.scalar_gate_swap: same gate targets, but keep each transform's low-rank output computed on recipient input; no donor input-vector transfer
protocol.weights: U, V, gate encoder, thresholds, and normalization statistics are never edited
protocol.primary_baseline: original Qwen plus deltas for BOTH decompositions; no wholesale transcoder or MOLT replacement
protocol.secondary_replacement: full layer-22 MOLT replacing native MLP, separately labeled, with no reconstruction-error addback

protocol.limits: Feature counts and selected layers differ between decompositions; same context/strength/protocol is not equal intervention magnitude. Norm-matched conditions are diagnostic. This is a semantic operand intervention, not a multi-hop reasoning test.
